capital: Kuala Lumpur · nearby Putrajaya is referred to as a federal government administrative center but not as the capital; the legislature meets in Kuala Lumpur
rulers: King Sultan IBRAHIM ibni al-Marhum Sultan Iskandar (since 31 January 2024); Prime Minister ANWAR Ibrahim (since 24 November 2022)
